description.vi: Công cụ và kỹ năng CSKH của Lohi, đặt trên team-cs: tra ví, gói, nạp LT, chương và audio của chính bạn đọc; yêu cầu truyện, dịch tiếp, Audio Pro, báo lỗi và gửi link nguồn cho cuốn bạn đọc theo dõi, qua danh tính do máy chủ ký.
description.en: Lohi's customer care tools and skills on top of team-cs: the reader's own wallet, plan, top-ups, chapters and audio, plus the one-book model (request a novel, continue translating, Audio Pro, report a defect, send a source link) through the host-signed principal.

tools.name: lohi_lookup
tools.title: Xem tài khoản của bạn đọc
tools.description: Read the chatting user's own account data (profile, wallet, top-ups, orders, subscription + the plan's monthly gas, requests, chapter unlocks), reading suggestions (kind=recommend: REQUIRED first step whenever the reader asks what to read or for novel suggestions — returns their taste + ranked unread candidates; optional like ("giống X")/about (story content)/q/genres/tags/status; never name novels from memory) or public novel/chapter data. Broken content / audio reports: kind=find_novel (q = the title or the lohi2.com link the reader gave → novelId, slug, chapterFromLink) plus closed[] = Lohi titles that exist but are closed, each with state restricted (đã bị thiên phạt, not public) or archived (không còn trên Lohi), viewer_can_open (this signed-in reader can still open it: the reader-page gate, e.g. a paid plan or reading history; archived never) and url (only when viewer_can_open). viewer_can_open true → say they can still read/listen and give url; false → say the state, never suggest a plan or payment opens it. Never 'Lohi chưa có', never a request for it; offer similar novels with recommend like=<title> (its `like` then carries state, viewer_can_open, url) THEN kind=content_health (novelId + from[/to] chapter numbers → per-chapter body verdict missing|empty|placeholder|untranslated|unpublished and Pro-audio verdict on_empty_text|placeholder|too_short, plus defect runs). REQUIRED before saying anything about a chapter or audio being broken. The reader's own data is scoped by the host's signed principal, never by a parameter; an anonymous conversation gets principal_required. Wrong character names: kind=name_check (novelId + name[+other] + from[/to], max 60 chapters) → how many chapters use each spelling and whether the Book Bible knows either; counts only, no chapter text. Product/plan questions: kind=features (optional q) → plans with CURRENT price, monthly gas (plans[].gasMonthly) and offline limit, free limits, LT costs, the gas block (price per chapter, gas a 'Muốn đọc' adds per plan, onboard threshold), and per feature web/iOS/Android availability + which plans unlock it. REQUIRED before answering any 'tính năng X có không / gói nào / giá / gas / trên iOS có không' question; never quote prices or gas numbers from memory. Requests (kind=requests): every book the reader requested OR backed, one row each with type (novel|chapters|quality), role (requester|supporter), stage (scoring|queued|needs_source|onboarding|translating|quality|audio|released|failed|…), stage_cause, progress {done,total} (translating/audio only, else null), needs_you (true = the reader's own source link is awaited), hub_url (the book's one page: /yeu-cau/<id>, or /truyen/<slug> once released). Say the stage and one number from this row, never a guess. Rankings (kind=ranks, board = novels (BXH Lohi: lượt đọc, period week|month) | yuepiao (BXH nguyệt phiếu Qidian, optional month YYYY-MM, rows are chart positions 1 = top) | donors | editors | hoa-than | voice-pro): REQUIRED before naming what ranks where. Each novel row carries state open (url to read) | restricted (bị thiên phạt; viewer_can_open + url when this reader can still open it) | archived (không còn trên Lohi) | missing (Lohi chưa có: offer a novel request); `boards` lists every board. Story characters and lore (any question about who a character is, their realm/role/relations, or what a place/sect/item/technique is): ONE call, no find_novel first. kind=characters (novel = the title, lohi2.com link or novelId as the reader gave it, or omit it when they did not name one: the api then searches the novels this reader read most recently; q = the name as the reader wrote it, typos/no accents fine; no q = the novel's best-loved characters) → novel, novel_source (asked | recent_reading: say which novel you mean), viewer_progress and each character's public sheet (role, personality, appearance, summary, realm, faction, first_chapter, url); or kind=wiki (same novel, q required) → matching wiki entries (type, text, first_chapter). REQUIRED before describing a character or story term; never from memory. Rows with spoiler_for_viewer=true are past this reader's chapter: say there are spoilers and ask before telling them. Empty with searched[] = not in the novels they read: ask which novel. 409 novel_ambiguous → choices[] (title, url): ask which one. 400 novel_required / 404 no_recent_reading → ask which novel. 404 novel_not_found → that title is not on Lohi. 403 novel_closed (title, state) → the title is closed to this reader.

novel.description: characters/wiki: the novel as the reader named it (title, lohi2.com link or novelId); omit when they did not name one.

q.description: recommend: the reader's wish as a topic/genre phrase or a title they want to FIND (never 'giống truyện đã đọc'/'đang hot'/'đã hoàn' — those are no q, or status). find_novel: a title, slug or lohi2.com link exactly as the reader gave it. features: the feature or plan the reader asks about (e.g. 'tải offline', 'hẹn giờ', 'audio pro'); empty = whole table. characters/wiki: the character or term name as the reader wrote it.

about.description: recommend only: what the story is ABOUT in the reader's own words — protagonist's trade/identity, events, relationships, world (e.g. 'nữ chính bác sĩ, xuyên về cổ đại, báo thù'); commas separate ideas. Matched fuzzily against each novel's story card; candidates from it carry reason `about`, and every candidate carries `premise` + `keywords` when its card exists.

like.description: recommend only: 'truyện giống X' — X's title, slug or lohi2.com link. Seeds similar novels from X itself; X is never returned. The response's `like` says which novel it resolved to (null = none).

tags.description: recommend only: story traits the 11 genres cannot express, comma separated, as the reader said them or as slugs — pairing (đam mỹ, bách hợp, ngôn tình, vô CP, hậu cung), ending (HE, BE, OE), lead (thường nhân lưu, vô địch lưu, phế vật lưu, hệ thống, nữ cường, xuyên sách…), role (y thuật, luyện đan, trận pháp, kinh doanh, mỹ thực, quân nhân, sát thủ, thiên tài, minh tinh, thể thao, ngự thú, lãnh chúa), setting (mạt thế, vô hạn lưu, linh dị…), trope (báo thù, xuyên nhanh, nữ phụ, trước hôn sau yêu, truy thê, thanh mai trúc mã, sư đồ, manh bảo, thật giả thiên kim, giấu nghề, livestream, đạo mộ), tone (sảng văn, ngược, sủng, hài hước, chữa lành, hắc ám). Candidates from it carry reason tag:<slugs>; the response's `tags` lists what was understood.

name.description: name_check: the spelling the reader says is WRONG, exactly as it appears in the chapter text.

other.description: name_check: the spelling the reader says is RIGHT (optional).

board.description: ranks only: novels (BXH Lohi, default) | yuepiao (nguyệt phiếu Qidian) | donors | editors | hoa-than | voice-pro.

period.description: ranks only: the window where the board has it (novels: week|month). Omit for the board's default.

month.description: ranks board=yuepiao only: the chart month YYYY-MM; omit for the newest complete chart.

tools.name: lohi_thread_history
tools.title: Đọc lại cuộc trò chuyện
tools.description: Read back what was already said in THIS conversation. Use it before answering when the newest message is not self-contained: the reader spread one problem over several messages, referred to something earlier ('cái đó', 'như mình nói'), or sent a follow-up whose subject is in a previous line. q finds a line by keyword (accent-insensitive); before=nextCursor keeps looking further back.

tools.name: lohi_subject_card
tools.title: Thẻ bạn đọc cho bàn hỗ trợ
tools.description: The reader card for a support console (interface.subject, subject.v1): who the signed-in reader is — name, email, user id, plan, LT balance, join date and latest top-up, with the 'Mở trên Lohi' admin link. Run by the host for the conversation's principal; not for answering the reader (use lohi_lookup for balances and prices, lohi_gas for a novel's gas).

tools.name: lohi_request_novel
tools.title: Gửi yêu cầu thêm truyện
tools.description: Create a novel request on behalf of the chatting user (type novel only, idempotent) after ONE confirm. The answer carries hub_url (the book's page: relative, prefix https://lohi2.com) plus gas {current, target, remaining} (the request's own gas tank) and stage; reply with that link. A duplicate returns the existing request (deduped:true) and the reader's 'Muốn đọc' is counted on it. If the reader pasted a source link, pass sourceUrl; a later link goes through lohi_send_source.

tools.name: lohi_request_chapters
tools.title: Xin dịch tiếp (hàng chờ miễn phí) / báo chất lượng dịch
tools.description: For a novel ALREADY on Lohi (novelId from find_novel). type chapters = the reader wants more chapters translated (Dịch tiếp, optional fromChapter): it files the ask and gives the reader a FREE place in the novel's wait queue (no LT is taken); chapters come when the novel's gas tank pays for them, in queue order. Then answer from lohi_gas / lohi_gas_quote numbers and offer their one link; never promise a chapter or a date. type quality = a translation-quality complaint (description required: what is wrong and where); a defect you can reproduce goes through lohi_report_content_issue first. Idempotent; several readers asking for one novel join ONE request (merged:true). Use this, not report_blocker, for 'translate more' and 'more chapters'. The answer carries hub_url when the api serves one.

tools.name: lohi_gas
tools.title: Xem bình gas của một truyện
tools.description: The gas tank of ONE novel on Lohi (1 LT = 1 gas; each novel has its own tank and Lohi translates its waiting chapters from it). REQUIRED before saying anything about a novel's gas, why chapters are not translated yet, when a chapter will come, or how to top up. Returns novel {slug,title}; gas {phase filling|running|low|dry|idle, balanceLt (gas in the tank), chaptersLeft (chapters the tank still pays for), chaptersWaiting (chapters not translated yet), queue {count, mine}, contributors, canTopUp, refusal {label}, topUp {presets, min, max}}; reach {first_waiting (first chapter not translated yet), auto_until (the last chapter Lohi translates on its own with this tank; null = nothing waits or the tank is dry), last_chapter}; top_up_url. Put top_up_url in the reply as the one button: the reader's thread shows it as the tank card with 'Nạp gas'. Optional gas = an amount the reader named (topUp.min..max): the link then opens on that amount (top_up_url, top_up_gas); 409 top_up_refused = the tank takes no gas now (say the served message). Read-only: you never top up and never spend. 404 novel_not_found = not on Lohi; 422 not_eligible = a Studio work (its gas is in Studio).

novel.description: the novel's slug (lohi_lookup find_novel) or the lohi2.com link the reader gave

gas.description: optional: the top-up amount the reader named, in gas

tools.name: lohi_gas_quote
tools.title: Báo giá dịch / giọng Pro cho bạn đọc
tools.description: What ONE gas action would cost THIS reader right now, computed by the api for the signed-in reader. Read-only: you never pay, never confirm. kind = translate_chapter (chapter) | translate_range (from,to; for 'muốn có tới chương N ngay': from = lohi_gas reach.first_waiting, to = N; the api clamps a long range and says so in quote.range) | tts_pro_create (Pro voice for chapters already translated). Returns novel, kind, quote {price (LT the reader's wallet would pay), priceGas (the whole price in gas), funding[] each with a served label (from the novel's tank, from the plan's gas, paid by the reader), reason {code}, shortfall, balance, canWait, range {from,to,chapters}}, resource, action_url, quoted_at. Say the range and the price in one sentence and put action_url in the reply: the reader's thread shows a quote card whose button re-quotes and lets the reader confirm. reason nothing_to_do = already translated/voiced; in_flight = already being done; insufficient_balance = the wallet is short by shortfall LT (the card offers buying LT); canWait = they can also wait for free (lohi_request_chapters). principal_required = the reader is not signed in.

novel.description: the novel's slug (lohi_lookup find_novel) or the lohi2.com link the reader gave

chapter.description: one chapter (translate_chapter, or a single Pro chapter)

tools.name: lohi_send_source
tools.title: Gửi link nguồn cho truyện đã yêu cầu
tools.description: Send a source link for a book the reader requested that is waiting on one (lohi_lookup requests row with needs_you:true, stage needs_source, or stage failed with stage_cause no_source; failed(no_source) is reopened). id = that row's id (from lohi_request_novel or lohi_lookup requests), url = the link the reader gave, exactly. Idempotent on (id, url). The api validates the link: invalid_source_url (details.reason) → ask for another link; wrong_stage → the book is not waiting for one; source_conflict → a different link is already waiting; not_open → the request is done or merged; forbidden → not the reader's book. Answer with hub_url. Never fetch or open the link yourself.

tools.name: lohi_request_audio_pro
tools.title: Báo giá Audio Pro cho bạn đọc
tools.description: Pro-voice audio for chapters of a novel already on Lohi: a QUOTE only (the api's tts_pro_create quote for the signed-in reader). It never creates audio and never spends; the reader creates it from the link. Returns quote {price (LT their wallet would pay), priceGas, funding[] each with a served label (from the novel's gas tank, from the plan's gas, paid by the reader), reason {code, label}, shortfall, range {from,to,chapters}} and action_url. Say the range and the price from it in one sentence and put action_url in the reply: the reader's thread shows a quote card whose button re-quotes and lets them confirm. reason nothing_to_do = already voiced; in_flight = already being made; a blocked reason (e.g. chapters not translated yet) is said as served, then lohi_gas_quote translate_range.

novelSlug.description: slug from lohi_lookup find_novel, or the lohi2.com link the reader gave

toChapter.description: optional; omitted = only fromChapter. The api clamps a long range.

tools.name: lohi_report_content_issue
tools.title: Báo lỗi nội dung cho đội hỗ trợ
tools.description: Ask the support team to fix a broken novel/chapter/audio defect that kind=content_health has ALREADY shown for this window. kind=content (chapters missing/empty/placeholder/untranslated) or kind=audio (Pro audio too short/placeholder on good text). The server re-checks the defect itself and refuses a healthy window; nothing is changed until a member approves it. Max 3 pending per conversation. Tell the reader it is queued for the team, never that it is fixed or when. An answer with `uncovered` names chapters whose TEXT is broken inside an audio report: file kind=content for that span too. kind=name (wrong character name): needs wrongName (+ rightName) and requires that kind=name_check showed the wrong spelling in the text; it opens a REVIEW for staff, who decide — never promise a rename. kind=text (a wrong passage in ONE chapter that the reader quoted or that you found): find = the passage copied verbatim from the chapter (the server refuses a quote that is not there), replace = the corrected text, short, expectOccurrences = how many places (1-3), summary = one line in your words (never the reader's message). A reviewer (Catalog Exec) checks it against the chapter and fixes it; the reader hears back from Lạc Phong when it is done.

note.description: the reader's complaint in one line

tools.name: lohi_recover_topup
tools.title: Kiểm tra và cộng khoản nạp SePay
tools.description: Recover a SePay top-up the reader paid but never received. Give the time window they paid in (from/to, ISO 8601 with offset, at most 72 h) and what they know (amountVnd, transferNote). The api checks this reader's own unfinished top-ups in that window with SePay and credits only when exactly one is paid; the LT comes from that top-up, never from you. Every call waits for the support team's approval first. Answers: {ltAmount, balanceAfter, topupId} credited; {already:true} already credited; not_found no top-up in the window; not_paid SePay has no confirmed payment yet (unverified lists top-ups SePay has no record of — never proof they did not pay); ambiguous several paid (candidates listed, nothing credited); amount_mismatch; not_creditable (reason; nothing credited); provider_unavailable (try later). Report only what it answered.

from.description: start of the window the reader paid in, e.g. 2026-10-28T13:30:00+07:00

to.description: end of the window, after from, at most 72 h later

amountVnd.description: the amount the reader says they transferred (a filter, not an amount to credit)

transferNote.description: the transfer note (nội dung chuyển khoản) if the reader has it

reason.description: one line for the approver: what the reader reported and why this fixes it

tools.name: lohi_fix_chapter
tools.title: Sửa một chương truyện
tools.description: Fix one chapter after the reader reported it. mode=replace: an exact wrong passage the reader quoted → find (exact text as it appears), replace (the corrected text) and expectOccurrences (how many places the reader says are wrong, default 1); the api refuses unless exactly that many matches exist (occurrences_mismatch {found}). mode=recrawl: a missing, empty or garbled chapter is fetched again from its source (not_recrawlable, job_active). novelId comes from lohi_lookup find_novel. Every call waits for the support team's approval first. One call per report.

find.description: replace only: the wrong text exactly as it appears in the chapter

replace.description: replace only: the corrected text (empty removes it)

expectOccurrences.description: replace only: how many places should change; default 1

reason.description: one line for the approver: what the reader reported and why this fixes it

LOHI_CS.title: Lohi CS API key
LOHI_CS.description: Read-only support key for the Lohi API (lookup, thread history, novel requests, content reports).

LOHI_CS_BASE.title: Lohi API base URL
LOHI_CS_BASE.description: Base URL of the Lohi API the support tools call.

LOHI_CS_EXEC.title: Lohi CS execution key
LOHI_CS_EXEC.description: Key for the support actions that change an account (top-up recovery, chapter fixes).
